verdict.rationale: Riveter supports scheduling projects to run on a cadence ('every minute' for fast-moving data) and webhook notifications on run completion, which enables autonomous background execution without manual triggering. However, there's no evidence of broader automation orchestration (e.g., conditional triggers, chaining multiple actions, or a dedicated automation/workflow builder) beyond scheduled data refresh. Missing for 10: evidence of multi-step autonomous workflows beyond scheduled enrichment refresh, independent/hands-on confirmation that scheduling works reliably in production, and any automation trigger types beyond time-based schedules.
